prompt.project_info: Create a candid late-night fast-food selfie with an anti-aesthetic digital-camera feel.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with messy hair under a colorful knitted beanie, wired headphones, bored deadpan expression, oversized vintage zip-up hoodie, enamel pins, and layered silver rings, holding a french fry near the camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Slumped comfortably in a bright red diner booth, phone held high with exaggerated but non-sexual 0.5x foreground distortion, red tray, burger wrappers, ketchup, neon window sign, checkered floor, and no sharp background faces.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh smartphone flash mixed with cold fluorescent light, black booth shadows, saturated red and yellow fast-food colors, grease smudges and digital noise.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 ultra-wide smartphone look, controlled barrel distortion, direct flash, photorealistic texture, candid Gen-Z photo-dump aesthetic.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult woman with messy hair tucked under a colorful knitted beanie and large wired headphones sits comfortably in a bright red plastic diner booth at 3 AM. She wears an oversized vintage zip-up hoodie with enamel pins and layered silver rings, holding a french fry near the camera with a bored deadpan expression. A phone held high creates playful 0.5x foreground distortion without changing anatomy. Include a red tray with burger wrappers and spilled ketchup, cold fluorescent lights, a soft neon window sign, and a checkered linoleum floor reflecting the flash. Use harsh smartphone flash, black booth shadows, saturated red and yellow colors, grease smudges, digital noise, and a chaotic ironic candid mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, body distortion, erotic food framing, nudity, readable brand logos, sharp background faces, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
